description: Use this when the user wants a flowchart, process diagram, decision tree or workflow chart from a list of steps and decisions, or wants Mermaid flowchart text drawn as an image or PDF. Takes text with one edge per line (A -> B, A -> B: label, Mermaid flowchart syntax) or nodes (id, text, shape: start, end, process, decision, input, document) with edges (from, to, label), plus top-down or left-right direction. Returns the laid-out chart in an interactive widget, layout checks (box overlaps, edge crossings), process checks (unknown ids with the line number, decisions with fewer than two branches, unreachable and dead-end steps), Mermaid text, and SVG, PDF and Mermaid downloads. Limits are 150 nodes and 300 edges. Does not draw swimlanes, org charts, mind maps, sequence diagrams or charts of data; does not save or share charts.

direction.description: Flow direction, e.g. top-down (default) or left-right.

edge_style.description: Arrow style, e.g. orthogonal (default, right-angle lines) or straight.

edges.description: Arrows between node ids, up to 300, e.g. [{"from":"q","to":"ship","label":"yes"}].

from.description: Id of the node the arrow starts at, e.g. "q".

label.description: Optional label up to 40 characters, e.g. "yes".

to.description: Id of the node the arrow points to, e.g. "ship".

nodes.description: Nodes, 1 to 150, e.g. [{"id":"s","text":"Start","shape":"start"},{"id":"q","text":"Paid?","shape":"decision"}]. Use with edges instead of text.

id.description: Short unique id used in edges, e.g. "check".

shape.description: start, end, process, decision, input or document, e.g. "decision". Defaults from the text: a question mark makes a decision, Start and End make start and end.

text.description: Text in the box, up to 120 characters, e.g. "In stock?". Defaults to the id.

page_size.description: PDF page, e.g. auto (default, page fits the chart at full size), letter or a4 (chart scaled to fit one page).

text.description:
The flowchart as text, one edge per line, e.g. "Start -> Check stock
Check stock -> In stock?
In stock? -> Ship: yes
In stock? -> Reorder: no". Node forms: id[Text] process, id{Question?} decision, id([Text]) start or end, id[/Text/] input or output, id@{ shape: doc, label: "Text" } document. Plain words are a node too. Labels: A -> B: label or A -->|label| B. Mermaid flowchart text works. Leave empty when you give nodes and edges.

title.description: Title shown above the chart and used for file names, up to 80 characters, e.g. "Order handling".

name: generate_flowchart
title: Generate flowchart
